name: CRP Robot
name_zh: 成都卡诺普机器人技术股份有限公司
summary: CRP Robot is a Chengdu-based Chinese manufacturer of industrial robots, collaborative robots and embodied-intelligence systems. Founded in 2012, the company develops robot controllers, core components and complete robots for manufacturing. Its humanoid portfolio includes wheeled robots designed to combine mobile navigation with two-arm industrial manipulation.
